title: Safer chat: report, block and a word filter
notes: 🚩 Report: tap Report in any game to report a rude player.
🔇 Block: blocked players can't chat with you, join your invites, challenge you, friend you or be matched with you. Unblock any time.
Chat now filters out swear words and slurs automatically.
This keeps Elo Ladder friendly for everyone — and gets it ready for the App Store.
